comparisons.name: network-top-light
comparisons.description: Top of the Network pane's service list with a grey selection, Aqua. Text is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms and the service icons are not reproduced.

comparisons.name: network-top-drawing-light
comparisons.description: Top of the Network pane's service list, Aqua: the same crop with the text and the service icons masked, which scores the frame, the selection, the row height and the status dots.

comparisons.name: network-footer-light
comparisons.description: Bottom of the Network pane's service list with its attached button bar, Aqua, at threshold 0.05. The action button's gear is the gradient button's stand-in artwork and is masked.

comparisons.name: network-top-dark
comparisons.description: Top of the Network pane's service list with a grey selection, Dark Aqua. Text is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms and the service icons are not reproduced.

comparisons.name: network-top-drawing-dark
comparisons.description: Top of the Network pane's service list, Dark Aqua: the same crop with the text and the service icons masked, which scores the frame, the selection, the row height and the status dots.

comparisons.name: network-footer-dark
comparisons.description: Bottom of the Network pane's service list, Dark Aqua, at threshold 0.05, with the button bar itself masked: the gradient button's Dark Aqua colours were measured in a locked pane (flat #3c3c3c) and differ from this pane's enabled bar (#4e4f50 to #48494a), which is that component's to correct. What is scored is the frame, the list background and where the bar ends.

comparisons.name: at-rest-light
comparisons.description: The states example before any input: the first row is selected and the list does not have the focus. Aqua.

comparisons.name: forced-colors-text-light
comparisons.description: Forced colours, after a click on the first row of a list whose text is full blocks and whose emphasised text colour is a marker (red): the title and the subtitle of the focused selection are the system's highlight text, not the marker. The colours are the browser's emulated system colours, not Catalina's.

its subtitle: HighlightText, not the marker

comparisons.name: forced-colors-text-not-key-light
comparisons.description: Forced colours in a window that is not key, after a click on the first row of the same list: the subtitle of the selected row is the system's highlight text, not the secondary label colour it has on a row that is not selected. The colours are the browser's emulated system colours, not Catalina's.
